card.name: The word case(s) after a count
card.fires_on: The word "case" or "cases" right after a count or quantity such as fatal, one, two, some or several, when describing adverse events in patients.

modes.label: Fatal cases
modes.description: "case(s)" right after the word fatal when reporting deaths from an event.
modes.example: There were two fatal<< cases>> of VTE (0.5%),

modes.label: Some or several cases
modes.description: "cases" after a vague quantity like some or several, in warning text.
modes.example: In several<< cases>>, these reactions occurred after the first dose

modes.label: Number then cases
modes.description: "cases" after a spelled-out number in event counts.

card.plain: It fires on the word "cases" when a label counts how many patients had an event.
